findings.title: Missing oracle price floor lets capped deposits overmint proUSD
findings.root_cause: setUSDPrice enforces a 1e18 minimum proUSD price, but in oracle price-source mode _getUsdRepresentationProToken uses the aggregated oracle price directly with no floor, so a low oracle price overmints proUSD on deposits.

findings.title: Capped yAsset redemptions can overpay when the live price exceeds usdCap
findings.root_cause: Redemption pricing divides by min(live yAsset price, usdCap), so when the live price is above the cap the user is paid out more yAsset than the USD value burned.

findings.title: proUSD price decreases can break StrategyVault withdrawal accounting
findings.root_cause: _accrueGrowth only ratchets lastPrice upward and books freed proUSD as growth; a later price decrease (allowed by setUSDPrice) is never unwound, so withdrawals priced at the current rate exceed the already-reduced withdrawProUSD reserve and revert.

findings.title: 1:1 unmint cap under-redeems proUSD when proUSD price is above 1 USD
findings.root_cause: The unmint path caps the yAsset output at the nominal proUSD amount instead of its USD value, so when proUSD trades above 1 USD redeemers receive less than they burned.

findings.title: StrategyVault.claimYield() leaves withdrawProUSD overstated, breaking vault solvency
findings.root_cause: claimYield transfers the protocol-reward proUSD out of the vault without decrementing withdrawProUSD, so the reserve ledger overstates holdings and user withdrawals are bricked.

findings.title: Median-relative validation permits oracle spreads above the configured maximum
findings.root_cause: Each source is compared to the median rather than to the other sources; with two sources the median is their mean, so the accepted spread between them is roughly twice the configured maxPriceDeviation.

findings.title: Queued unmint burns proUSD before the yAsset payout is guaranteed
findings.root_cause: On approval _executeUnmint burns the escrowed proUSD before checking payout liquidity; if the queued batch is never processed and funded the user has lost the proUSD with no on-chain recourse.

findings.title: StrategyVault.regive() and StrategyVault.rotate() can underfund withdrawals
findings.root_cause: Starting an unbonding does not earmark any of the shared withdraw reserve, so regive/rotate can move reserve funds away before completeWithdraw, which then reverts WithdrawReserveUnderfunded.

findings.title: Algebra TWAP adaptor misdetects staleness via tick-cumulative equality
findings.root_cause: Equal tick cumulatives are treated as stale, but they just mean an average tick of 0 (price ~1.0), so stable/stable pools at parity revert StaleOracleData while genuine staleness goes undetected.

findings.title: Pull oracle adapters are unusable
findings.root_cause: The only call site passes empty bytes as oracle data, but both pull adaptors require a signed payload, so configuring either as a price source makes every mint and unmint revert.
